title: Stop Buying Salad Dressing
hook: Store-made salad dressing can ruin a good salad.
body: Skip the bottle. Pour olive oil right on the meal, add pepper and garlic powder, then the vinegar. Olive oil is 120 calories a tablespoon, so measure it instead of pouring freehand.
close: Save this for your next salad.
